$comment: T-3.25. The squad's two fireteams of three (§1.2), by slot index, fixed: slot order is fireteam order. Each follows its lead in its own formation. A formation is offsets from the lead, [right, back] in metres in the lead's direction of travel, one per follower rank: the lead's own fireteam first, then the other, each in slot order, so the other fireteam falls in behind when both follow one lead — in file, down the middle of the wedge. Stopped (under stillMps), the lead's followers close up to closeUpScale of those offsets. A follower walks when the lead walks and sprints when the lead sprints — or when it is more than catchUpM from its place, to rejoin; within arriveM of its place with the lead still, it stands. A place nearer the lead than minFromLeadM (a wall squeezed it in) is refused for the one straight behind. While the lead sprints, the offsets to the side close to sprintSpreadScale: a running fireteam tightens up, and a follower on the outside of a corner cannot outrun a lead who is already running. bandM + bandPerM × the offset's length: how far from its place a follower may be and still count as in formation — what the tests hold it to over a route (looser the further back the place). T-3.26, bot: a friendly bot sees, aims and fires by `archetype`'s perception and accuracy (an enemies.json row) with the slot's own gun; takes cover only at points within its formation band (bandM + bandPerM × its offset) of its formation place; holds fire while a squadmate's capsule, grown by friendlyMarginM, is on the line to its aim point; and revives a downed squadmate within reviveSeekM, holding interact from reviveReachFraction of the revive range.
